title: Top-2 routing with a little room to spare
notes: Every token picks two experts, and a softmax over the two scores gives the weights: 0.82 and 0.18 for most tokens, 0.74 and 0.26 for on. E2 and E4 are asked for 4 each, exactly their capacity of ⌈1.25 × 2 × 6 / 4⌉ = 4, so nothing is dropped. The loss is 1.06: small words are common, so E4 is a little too popular.
